title: X.Org Server libXrender RenderQueryPictFormats Reply Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of X.Org Server. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must connect to a malicious X11 server.
The specific flaw exists within the XRenderQueryFormats function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process.
addtionnal_details:
X.Org has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/xorg/lib/libxrender/-/merge_requests/19
